name: day1_orders_vs_baseline
sql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders.orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-24'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-25'
),
b AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / 7 AS cnt
  FROM orders.orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-17'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-24'
)
SELECT w.cnt AS value, ROUND(b.cnt, 4) AS baseline
FROM w, b;

name: day1_seller_spike
sql:
WITH window_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, oi.seller_id
  FROM orders.orders o
  JOIN orders.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-24'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-25'
),
baseline_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, oi.seller_id
  FROM orders.orders o
  JOIN orders.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-17'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-24'
),
window_counts AS (
  SELECT seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS window_orders
  FROM window_orders
  GROUP BY seller_id
),
baseline_counts AS (
  SELECT seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS baseline_orders
  FROM baseline_orders
  GROUP BY seller_id
)
SELECT
  wc.seller_id,
  wc.window_orders,
  ROUND(COALESCE(bc.baseline_orders, 0) / 7.0, 4) AS baseline_avg_daily_orders,
  ROUND(wc.window_orders * 1.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(bc.baseline_orders, 0) / 7.0, 0), 4) AS spike_ratio
FROM window_counts wc
LEFT JOIN baseline_counts bc ON wc.seller_id = bc.seller_id
ORDER BY spike_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20;

name: day1_category_mix
sql:
WITH window_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    pct.product_category_name_english AS category
  FROM orders.orders o
  JOIN orders.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN orders.products pr ON oi.product_id = pr.product_id
  JOIN orders.product_category_name_translation pct
    ON pr.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-24'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-25'
),
baseline_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    pct.product_category_name_english AS category
  FROM orders.orders o
  JOIN orders.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN orders.products pr ON oi.product_id = pr.product_id
  JOIN orders.product_category_name_translation pct
    ON pr.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-17'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-24'
),
category_counts_window AS (
  SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS cnt
  FROM window_orders
  GROUP BY category
),
category_counts_baseline AS (
  SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS cnt
  FROM baseline_orders
  GROUP BY category
),
top3_window AS (
  SELECT category
  FROM category_counts_window
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
top3_baseline AS (
  SELECT category
  FROM category_counts_baseline
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
window_top3_orders AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wo.order_id) AS top3_cnt
  FROM window_orders wo
  JOIN top3_window t ON wo.category = t.category
),
window_total_orders AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wo.order_id) AS total_cnt
  FROM window_orders wo
),
baseline_top3_orders AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bo.order_id) AS top3_cnt
  FROM baseline_orders bo
  JOIN top3_baseline t ON bo.category = t.category
),
baseline_total_orders AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bo.order_id) AS total_cnt
  FROM baseline_orders bo
)
SELECT
  ROUND(w.top3_cnt * 1.0 / wt.total_cnt, 4) AS value,
  ROUND(b.top3_cnt * 1.0 / bt.total_cnt, 4) AS baseline
FROM window_top3_orders w, window_total_orders wt, baseline_top3_orders b, baseline_total_orders bt;

name: day1_duplicate_rows
sql:
WITH window_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_order_ids,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS duplicate_rows
  FROM orders.orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-24'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-25'
),
baseline_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_order_ids,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS duplicate_rows,
    (COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)) / 7.0 AS avg_daily_duplicate_rows
  FROM orders.orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-17'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-24'
)
SELECT
  w.duplicate_rows AS value,
  ROUND(b.avg_daily_duplicate_rows, 4) AS baseline,
  w.total_rows AS window_total_rows,
  w.distinct_order_ids AS window_distinct_order_ids
FROM window_stats w, baseline_stats b;

name: day1_price_and_installments
sql:
WITH window_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    SUM(oi.price) AS order_total_price,
    MAX(CASE WHEN op.payment_installments > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_discount
  FROM orders.orders o
  JOIN orders.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN payments.order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-24'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-25'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
),
baseline_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    SUM(oi.price) AS order_total_price,
    MAX(CASE WHEN op.payment_installments > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_discount
  FROM orders.orders o
  JOIN orders.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN payments.order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-17'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-24'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(wo.order_total_price), 4) AS avg_price_window,
  ROUND(AVG(bo.order_total_price), 4) AS avg_price_baseline,
  ROUND(SUM(wo.has_discount) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS discount_prop_window,
  ROUND(SUM(bo.has_discount) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS discount_prop_baseline
FROM window_orders wo, baseline_orders bo;

name: types_orders_payments
sql:
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_status, o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date,
       o.order_estimated_delivery_date, p.payment_installments, p.payment_value
FROM orders.orders o
JOIN payments.order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL OR p.payment_value = 0
ORDER BY o.order_id, p.payment_sequential
LIMIT 8
note: Not a Day 1 query: covers timestamp, date, null, int and decimal (including zero) conversion.

name: scoped_payments_by_type
sql:
SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payments, ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS total_value
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY payment_type
note: Not a Day 1 query: a source-scoped statement with an unqualified table name.
